question: On a fixed 400-node 3d churn, multi-cadence gauge fixture, is stock-O1 ClickHouse TimeSeries with opt-in RAW_UUID layout competitive with pinned VictoriaMetrics v1.134.0 for exact same full PromQL query_range under 1/4/8 concurrent clients and bounded memory? Which selector classes reverse the outcome?
fixture: Deterministic R01 400 node 3d multi-cadence 15/60/300s TimeSeries fixture; SHA256 ea9a8d43c9e58ed916f1bf43949556d8ed18169ddd14033c293af4cd54c9881d; exactly 28,896 series and 2,488,320 samples; every sample imported to both engines unchanged.
window: [1d] aggregation evaluated on exact 3 daily grid timestamps; same expr on both engines
math_and_falsifiers: For 400 active node slots and 3h lifetime, 3d produces 28,896 IDs and 2,488,320 sample points. A valid cross-engine comparison requires exact label/time/value parity at each daily step, same sample input SHA and each engine's native supported query_range path. Compare QPS and CPU/request; more physical rows is not automatically more CPU. If VM/CH numeric semantics diverge, invalidate benchmark for that selector and record differences without performance ranking.
method: One ubuntu-24.04 runner, load identical data into both engines, verify full ingest and VM visibility, stop CH background merges and record VM state, interleave VM/CH/CH/VM phases, each 2 warmups+8 measured concurrent waves for 1/4/8 clients. Per wave barrier sync, full output equality; p50/p95/p99, completed requests/s, process CPU jiffies per request, low-overhead 4Hz RSS, CH QueryFinish CPU and physical reads, operator trace diagnostic when available. Reject baseline A/A drift>25%. Preserve all trial outcomes and settings.
safety: No new C++ builds, no prod mutation, no force push, no cancellations, no schedule; same-runner data only. VM -search.disableCache and nocache=1. CH query max_threads=2; VM thread policy native, not a per-engine identical thread setting. VM process memory setting is not hard RSS cgroup limit; show this limit explicitly.
owner_boundary: Do not duplicate R02 live write+merge, R04 TTL, R05 physical mark pruning, R10 bucket tuning, R13 regex rewrite, R14 exact grid rollup or R15 partition.
baseline: ClickHouse 26.10 pinned source 52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde stock LLVM22.1.8 O1 binary SHA256 f0a2fa1f814c58853f43423705cac10ab9df3bfe5887e27ebe9620ba7cb9660e, opt-in RAW UUID TimeSeries table and 3600s SAMPLES bucket.
candidate: VictoriaMetrics v1.134.0 single-node pinned GitHub artifact run 41288854734 SHA256 cd6e109bae85ff7c138d838b32be9a7fe2a6d7a9b3a387a7cf9234f22991da10. The engine, not a ClickHouse patch, is the one tested variable.
single_variable: Query engine: full native ClickHouse prometheusQueryRange on opt-in RAW UUID v11 versus VictoriaMetrics 1.134.0 query_range. Same PromQL expression, evaluation timestamps, full source fixture SHA and host; engines configured with their native supported threading/caches, differing allocator and query execution models are declared confounders.
math_bound: All records describe the same 28,896 logical series and 2,488,320 points. For any specified selector and daily 1d avg_over_time expression, outputs must match in labels, evaluation timestamps and finite numeric values. Bounded comparison valid only when VM/CH full output parity and A/A same-engine drift <=25% pass; no theoretical speed ranking assumed.
falsifier: Different label/time/value results, incomplete VM import, mismatched binary/fixture SHA, engine errors, OOM, VM matching-series cap or baseline A/A drift above 25% invalidate that case and prohibit a performance claim. Independent process RSS and CPU budget limits are declared, not assumed identical.
test_matrix: 4 selectors node_broad, pod_namespace, pod_broad, burst15; 3 daily evaluation timestamps; simultaneous clients 1/4/8, synchronized barriers, 2 warmup+8 measured waves, VM/CH/CH/VM. Collect p50/p95/p99, completed QPS, process CPU per request, RSS, CH query_log, identical output and stable physical parts.
runner_budget: One isolated ubuntu-24.04 runner, 130 min maximum, using already built CH stock O1 and VM1.134.0 binary from GitHub artifacts; no new C++ builds, cache mutations, schedules or cancellation of other runs.
planned_workflow: .github/workflows/ts-lab-r03-ch-vm-k8s-concurrent-20261103.yml (self-path-only push trigger, unique run_id concurrency group, cancel-in-progress false).
